title: CoCo-CoLa: Evaluating and Improving Language Adherence in Multilingual LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language adherence using the novel CoCo-CoLa (Correct Concept - Correct Language) metric on a closed-book Question-Answering (CBQA) task across seven languages, specifically measuring the model's bias toward generating responses in a high-resource language (English) rather than the intended input language.
